name: fm-league
description: FM27 风格轻度 Rogue 足球联赛（Steam & 微信小游戏双端同构）

scripts.build:web: esbuild apps/steam/src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=apps/steam/steam.bundle.js && esbuild packages/engine/src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=FMLeagueEngine --minify --outfile=apps/steam/engine.iife.js && node scripts/gen_ota_manifest.mjs
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:web && npx electron apps/steam/electron/main.cjs
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build:web && npx electron-builder --config apps/steam/electron-builder.json --dir
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:web && npx electron-builder --config apps/steam/electron-builder.json
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && node scripts/build_android_web.mjs && npx cap sync android
